_comment: ChingMu CALLBACK sensor id -> GMR smplx body name. Values are exactly the 14 targets GMR's smplx_to_g1 IK uses (retarget.ik_match_table1). Sensor ids are from the tracker-data callback (callback_data.py / retarget_server_gmr.py --probe), NOT the polling API. Keys starting with '_' are ignored (docs).
_left_right_note: Assumes +Y = operator LEFT. If the retarget comes out mirrored, swap the left_/right_ ids below.
_tuning_note: If feet float/sink try left_foot->317 / right_foot->321 (ankles). If the torso leans, try spine3->302. Rotation twist -> tune --rot-format / --euler-order.
